filesystem.description: The mount point or device path of the XFS filesystem to dump.

dump_level.description: Dump level argument. 0 for full dump, 1-9 for incremental.

media_protocol.description: Minimal tape protocol flag. '-m' for non-scsi or remote tape.

exclude_no_dump.description: Allow files with 'no dump' attribute to be skipped. '-e'.

subtree_flags.description: List of pathnames (relative to mount point) to restrict dump to. Uses '-s' flag for each.

media_label_flags.description: List of media labels for destinations. Uses '-M' flag for each.

max_file_size.description: Max file size in KB to include. '-z <size>'.

dump_time_flag.description: Set dump time based on file modification time. '-t <file>'.

destinations.description: List of dump destinations. Each item has 'path' (file/device) and optional 'media_label'. If media_label is provided, '-M <label>' is added before '-f <path>'.
